content: There is currently no definitive treatment available; the primary approach to therapy is supportive care. Supportive care includes interventions aimed at managing symptoms and maintaining physiological stability. The majority of cases are self-limiting and typically require only supportive care measures. Certain conditions represent medical emergencies and necessitate immediate and prompt treatment to prevent severe outcomes. The cornerstone of treatment for such conditions is tailored to the specific clinical scenario. The optimal therapeutic approach depends on the stage of the disease at the time of diagnosis and may vary accordingly.
